result: Implemented and authorized the one-shot Kaggle CPU full sAlex/WBM component run. The workflow binds an exact Rhombus commit into a private per-commit Kaggle dataset and CPU kernel, verifies the frozen Matbench commit/blob identities and WBM source, executes the complete 10,447,765-record sAlex stream, emits 128 MiB chunked zstd outputs, self-dispatches GitHub controller continuations if Kaggle outlives one polling job, retrieves terminal outputs, and independently verifies per-part/compressed/decompressed hashes plus frozen row counts. This authorization is limited to the sAlex exposure component; MPTrj remains unresolved and unseen-generalization authority remains closed.
